newsitem.title: USA: HL&P says 7,200 without power after Houston storm.
newsitem.headline: HL&P says 7,200 without power after Houston storm.

text.p: Houston Lighting and Power Co (HL&P) said about 7,200 electricity customers in the Houston area remained without power Wednesday morning following a severe thunderstorm early Tuesday afternoon.
Repair crews worked through the night to restore local distribution lines after the storm cut power to over 234,000 people in the Houston area Tuesday afternoon, an HL&P spokeswoman said.
No major power transmission lines were damaged in the storm, the spokeswoman said.
Remaining customers without power were expected to have electricity restored Wednesday afternoon, she said.
The Tuesday storm spawned at least three funnel clouds as it moved through Harris County toward the southeast and the Gulf coast.
HL&P is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
